brief: Stand-in read written after the open. The AI chip selloff spread overnight (Nikkei sharply lower) and Nasdaq opened about 1.4% down, below yesterday's range, wiping out the post-midterm rally. VIX jumped more than 50%, its biggest one-day spike in over two years. Falling yields (10-yr near 4.83%) and a dollar near one-month lows help at the margin but don't offset the risk-off tape. Fed's Hammack and Barkin are on the calendar; no clear tone yet.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: Nasdaq plunges amid chip stock wipeout
